tonight.headline: Tuten missed Wednesday's practice — Sunday is now a two-player check
body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten did not practise Wednesday (ankle/foot, RotoWire 11 Nov) and ESPN now lists him questionable; Garrett Wilson is back at practice but still in the concussion protocol; Denzel Boston, his fallback, was held out Wednesday with a toe injury; and Jefferson's quarterback is now an open question after Minnesota traded for Kirk Cousins on Tuesday.

ESPN: 132.6 to 120.2, 56%. The lineup as set is still the projection lineup — nothing to change before Sunday. At 10:30 CDMX Sunday, two checks: Tuten (if out, Warren to RB and Metcalf at FLEX) and Wilson (if out, Boston; if Boston is out too, Metcalf).

case.label: Their side
case.body: Nicky Jam still start Colston Loveland at TE on a Chicago bye week at 22:05Z — a zero unless they notice. Hunter Henry sits on their bench, so the fix is one tap away for them.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten and Wilson both inactive with Boston also out: the lineup then needs Metcalf at FLEX and Allgeier at RB, and the 56% would fall.

whatWentWrong.title: This morning's Tuten read did not survive the afternoon
whatWentWrong.lead: The 07:00 brief had him ACTIVE with no Week 10 designation; he missed Wednesday's practice and is now questionable.

case.label: What changed
case.body: RotoWire (11 Nov, via the Florida Times-Union's Ryan O'Halloran): Tuten (ankle/foot) was a non-participant Wednesday. The morning brief wrote that the START 'changes if Jacksonville list him after Wednesday's practice' — that condition fired.

case.label: What it means
case.body: Not a bench. He played Week 9 through the same ankle after missing practice. It is a contingency at Sunday 10:30 CDMX, with Metcalf at FLEX the better cover than the tool's Allgeier.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten limited or full Thursday or Friday — then the contingency is a formality.
